column2: Slow arc camera move around the two brothers at their desk, the older brother with glasses points at the monitor and explains, the younger brother in the lavender hoodie nods and types quickly, monitor light flickers on their faces, they exchange a confident glance and smile. Keep their faces consistent.

Slow cinematic push-in on the two brothers on the rooftop at sunrise, they smile, then slowly turn their heads to look out at the sunrise over the Seoul skyline, wind moves their hair and hoodie, the younger brother puts a hand on his older brother's shoulder, lens flare blooms. Keep their faces consistent.
